text:
For a slim Qi2 power bank for the iPhone 17, I'd get the **Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo, Slim)**. I couldn't read the Android Central roundup, because the page came back truncated. This is based on 9to5Mac's picks and Anker's own product page.

**Top pick: [Anker Nano Power Bank 5K](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank), $54.99**
- It's 0.34 in (8.6 mm) thick and weighs 4.3 oz (122 g).
- Wireless charging is up to 15W, and Anker's page calls it Qi2-certified. Its feature list says only "Qi2-compatible", and one spec line says 5W max, so the certification and wattage are a little unclear.
- 9to5Mac calls it the closest alternative to Apple's MagSafe battery, and its top pick for slimness and build quality.
- The 5,000mAh rating is optimistic. Anker's page estimates that only about 2,750–3,500mAh is usable. That's likely under one full iPhone charge, so treat it as a top-up.

**Other options**
- **Budget: [Baseus MagSafe Battery Bank 5K](https://amzn.to/4p29cEb), $24.99.** It's about as thin as the Anker. It isn't Qi2, so wireless charging tops out at 7.5W. It charges at 20W over USB-C.
- **More capacity: [UGREEN MagSafe Battery 10,000mAh](https://amzn.to/4wjaE7M), $59.99.** It does up to 25W wireless (Qi2.2, iPhone 16 or later) and 30W wired. It's thicker, so it isn't a slim pick.
- **Premium: [Belkin 25W Battery Bank 10K](https://amzn.to/4oUnhn6), $99.99.** It's a bit chunky. It has a second magnetic ring for accessories and an LED capacity display.
- **Baseus PicoGo AM52 (10,000mAh, 45W, Qi2.2):** It's [listed at $59.99](https://dealectric.com/lab/V8/baseus-picogo-am52-qi2-2-10000mah-45w), and a deal page says code AM52 takes $6 off at Baseus's US store. I couldn't verify the code or the slimness. A 10,000mAh pack is unlikely to be as slim as the 5K models.
- **LISEN P601 (5,000mAh, Qi2 15W, 0.38 in):** [Product page](https://lisenintl.com/products/p601-magsafe-power-bank/). I didn't read it, so I can't vouch for it beyond the listing.

If you want the thinnest pack that charges at full Qi2 speed, get the Anker. If you'd rather have more capacity and don't mind the bulk, get the UGREEN.
